vector_set: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 — tagged ordering profiles and record modes
note: Abstract domain, epoch and object identifiers only. No observation or sequence domain from any external source is represented.

cases.rule: A sequenced record must match the domain and epoch of its artifact profile.
A reference record uses object id, revision, knowledge time and assertion id; its artifact profile carries neither domain nor epoch.
A record carries exactly one mode; the sequenced tagged branch forbids the reference key set.
A reference profile carries neither domain nor epoch; additional members are rejected.
The artifact-level profile is a tagged object, never a bare string.
The record's mode and domain/epoch must match the artifact profile that contains it.
Sequence numbers on the wire are decimal strings matching the ratified grammar; no coercion from integer.
Known gaps stay visible; no sequence number is fabricated to close one.

cases.condition: a caller attempts to sort records by an event-time field when no ordering mode is present
cases.rule: Event time is never a sort key and no fallback to event time exists.
